result.notes:
VERDICT: SHIP. All four verdicts stand: E19-H93 Refuted, E19-H94 Confirmed, E19-H96 Confirmed, E19-H97 Refuted. 4 minor findings, none of which changes a verdict or a count.

Checks 1 to 11:
(1) Cell 9 asserts the 18 hashes and cell 10 asserts at least 5 positives per note; the first score is computed in cell 12. Labels follow the `rule` field of labels.json. Neutral is applied before positive; this has no effect because no statement is both.
(2) Cell 16 prints both gates (0.6374 against 0.95; 0.5835 against 0.65) before the clause booleans of cells 18, 20 and 22. Cell 14 prints the top-3 hit counts before the gate cell; that line holds no bar comparison.
(3) Bars in cell 7 equal the registered text: 0.80 and 10 of 13; 0.03 and 10 of 13; 0.70 and 0.10; gates 0.95 and 0.65. The fixed cutoff is the package constant 0.32527. No parameter is chosen on the scored data. The registered batch has no control clause. The four ledger blocks hash to the registered values, so no bar changed after registration.
(4) The result file reports/E19-relevance/results/B.json equals the metrics file at full precision for every per-note AUC, balanced accuracy, rank and count, and for every clause value and boolean. Every key number is printed in cells 16 to 28.
(5) See `recomputed`.
(6) Every mean runs over NOTE_IDS (13 notes). The note 760391 is in no per-note dictionary of the metrics file and in no background: `BACKGROUND = {nid: [b for b in NOTE_IDS if b != nid] ...}`.
(7) The unit rule matches the primer and the batch opening (a statement belongs to its deepest unit; units below 5 such statements and neutral units are left out). Sensitivity with subtree sizes in place of own sizes: baseline 6/13, still below 10.
(8) 0 error outputs. The log line 'Writing 222249 bytes' equals the 222249 characters of the notebook file (247597 bytes on disk because of multi-byte characters); log and notebook share the modification time 06:48:08.
(9) Each verdict equals the conjunction of its clauses in the result, the metrics file and the notebook.
(10) See findings 1 and 4; every other sentence of cell 32 matches a printed number.
(11) `git status --short` holds 29 lines. This notebook's files are the untracked notebook, the untracked metrics file and reports/E19-relevance/results/B.json; the log and the npz file are git-ignored. The notebook source has two write calls (METRICS_FILE, COSTS_FILE). The tracked files changed between 06:42 and 06:46 (src/docdistance/cli.py, src/docdistance/pipeline.py, tests/test_e2e.py, CHANGELOG.md, README.md, docs/api-reference.md, docs/cli-reference.md, the docdistance SKILL.md) are not written by any cell of the notebook.

Could each test have failed: a score equal to the baseline gives a mean difference of 0 and 0 notes above 0, so E19-H94 and E19-H96 would read Refuted; a constant match map gives a balanced accuracy of 0.5; the contrast uses no label. Two notes share the target 3.2.3, so the sign-test p value of the registered bar assumes more independence than the 13 notes have; cell 32 says this. E19-H94 counts 13 of 13 with one note at +0.0011; the clause needs 10.

Disclosure about my own run: my first scratch script wrote its pickle through a relative path into the repository root (stage1.pkl, 06:52). I moved it to the scratch directory in the next command; the repository status is back to the same 29 lines. I edited no repository file and did not execute the notebook.
